Body / scale: Catedráticas y Catedráticos de Universidad
Who governs / runs it: Individual public university governs employment under its statutes; full teaching/research capacity (LOSU art. 68)
Recruitment / convening authority: University calls competitions for budgeted posts (art. 71)
Temario adoption / publication: University sets assessment merits in convocatoria/internal rules; not one national opposition temario
Who appoints / constitutes tribunal: Majority external commission, drawn publicly from qualified list, under university internal rules (art. 71)
How topics are tested (selected excerpts: Doctorate and prior ANECA accreditation; merit competition including teaching and research/transfer experience
Post-exam training route: No national post-opposition selective-course requirement identified in LOSU arts. 68-71; university development differs
Coverage / evidence caveat: Framework only, not every university/discipline notice; later regulatory changes not fully audited. No claimed individual rector, commission member or political orientation-setter.

Body / scale: Local: Administración General - Subescala Técnica
Who governs / runs it: Each corporation creates/classifies posts within statutory scales (RDL 781/1986 art. 167)
Recruitment / convening authority: President of the corporation calls selection; local delegation and specific notice require checking
Temario adoption / publication: Each corporation approves theoretical programmes within national minimum rules (RD 896/1991 art. 8); specific temario in local bases
Who appoints / constitutes tribunal: Local bases establish technical panel (RD 896/1991 arts. 3-4), read with TREBEP art. 60: no elected/political appointees, interims or eventual staff
Post-exam training route: Practices/course only where applicable local/regional rules prescribe it
Coverage / evidence caveat: Statutory class/subscale, not every local post, category or municipality. Group, current authority, panel individuals and compulsory course require the actual local/regional notice. Old RD 896 political panel-president text must be read subject to later TREBEP art. 60.
